title: Riced theme manifest
description: Schema for a Riced theme.toml. Drives editor autocomplete and inline validation through the taplo LSP. The canonical contract — Go's manifest.Manifest mirrors this file. When a field changes here, also update internal/manifest and docs/MANIFEST.md.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Must be 1. Future breaking changes will bump this; additive fields keep version 1.

name.description: Human-readable theme name. Shown in `riced themes` / `riced list`.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier unique within the repository. Used as the filename stem of every generated artifact (e.g. <slug>.colors).

mode.description: Color mode this manifest targets. Optional — ship the modes you have; Riced won't enforce dark/light pairs.

theme.description: Optional design-family identifier (e.g. "red", "mixed"). Themes sharing this value are grouped together in `riced themes`. Purely informational.

inherits.description: Slug of a parent theme whose fields are merged underneath this one. Parent is searched among siblings, then in ~/.riced/themes, then in registered repositories. Multi-level chains and cycle detection are supported.

Palette.description: Named colors driving every renderer. bg / text / accent are required AFTER the inheritance chain is fully resolved — the schema doesn't enforce that on a single file because child themes inherit those from their parent. The runtime `riced validate` checks the merged result.

allOf.description: Must be relative to the theme directory — absolute paths are rejected to keep manifests portable.
Path traversal segments ('..') are rejected. Filesystem symlinks at the theme dir level are how you point outside the theme.

RelativeAssetPath.description: Path to an asset (image, icon) inside the theme directory. Symlinks at the filesystem level are allowed and how you share a wallpaper pool across variants.

Wallpapers.description: Wallpaper configuration. `single` mode picks the first path; `slideshow` rotates through all of them. For multi-screen rigs, [[screens]] takes precedence over the flat `paths` list.

mode.description: Wallpaper plugin: a single image or a folder slideshow.

interval.description: Seconds between slides. Required when mode = "slideshow".

paths.description: Ordered list of wallpaper file paths, relative to the theme directory. Spread to every screen by default.

mirror.description: Reserved for explicit mirror semantics. Today behaves the same as a flat paths list spread to every screen. Mutually exclusive with [[screens]].

screens.description: Per-screen wallpaper lists. Each entry binds a screen index (Plasma's desktop.screen, 0-based) to its own image list. Overrides `paths` when present.

Panel.description: Plasma panel layout: position, floating mode, and the launcher icon override.

position.description: Which screen edge the panel docks to.

floating.description: Plasma's floating panel mode (panel detaches from the screen edge with a gap).

height.description: Panel thickness in pixels. 0 means "Plasma default".

launcher_icon.description: Path to an image file used as the application launcher icon. Replaces CachyOS's default "C" / KDE's blue rocket.

decoration.description: Window decoration library. klassy must be installed via paru/yay; breeze ships with Plasma.

animations.description: Minimize/restore animation. Only one is enabled at a time — Riced disables the others when applying.

animation_speed.description: kwinrc [Compositing] AnimationSpeed slider position. 0=instant, 3=KDE default, 6=very slow. Omit to leave the user's current setting alone.

animation_duration_ms.description: Override the active animation's duration in milliseconds. Bypasses the AnimationSpeed slider cap (~1s at speed 6). Written to [Effect-<animations>] AnimationDuration in kwinrc.

blur.description: Enable KWin's blur effect behind translucent windows.

wobbly.description: Enable KWin's wobbly-windows effect. Heavy on the eyes — off by default.

Fonts.description: Font family overrides. Riced does not bundle fonts — the families must already be installed on the target system.

mono.description: Monospace font family for Konsole and code (e.g. "JetBrains Mono").

opacity.description: Background opacity. 1.0 = fully opaque, 0.0 = fully transparent. Lands in the .colorscheme's [General] Opacity key.
